resources.string: Reads weight and sleep from the last 30 days. The data comes from Health Connect. It isn’t uploaded to the club and isn’t written back to Health Connect.
Health Connect Isn’t Available on This Device
You can still use all manual logging features.
Health Connect Needs to Be Installed or Updated
On Android 13 and lower, Health Connect is a separate app from Google Play.
No permission was granted, so nothing is connected.
Each sleep day runs from 18:00 the day before to 18:00 that day. Only sleep stages count. Overlapping sources aren’t added twice, and awake or out-of-bed stages don’t count as sleep.
This doesn’t affect manual logs or change the original data in Health Connect.
You can grant weight and sleep separately. When no samples are readable, missing values aren’t shown as zero.
Samples appear only while the app runs and aren’t written to the export file. Manual logs are stored separately, and health data doesn’t overwrite them.
You can manage Lean Muscle’s access in Health Connect. Disconnecting only clears what this app shows. It doesn’t revoke the permissions or delete records in Health Connect.
Health Connect has no waist record type, so waist stays a manual log.

Also disconnects Health Connect. Records in Health Connect aren’t deleted.
How Lean Muscle Uses Health Data
Lean Muscle reads two data types from Health Connect: weight and sleep sessions. It reads the last 30 days, only while the app is open.
Lean Muscle shows the latest weight, the sleep hours of each sleep day, and the app that wrote each record. It doesn’t write, change or delete anything in Health Connect.
The data stays in memory while the app runs. It isn’t saved to the device, isn’t included in the export file and isn’t sent to the club or to anyone else.
